agency: San Diego Humane Society / County Animal Services
note: Dog licensing is handled by the County/Humane Society, not the City.

agency: San Diego Humane Society (the City's animal control partner)
note: Call 619-299-7012 extension 1, staffed 24 hours a day, to report a stray, loose, injured or aggressive dog or cat. A dead animal on a public street is a Get It Done report instead.
Register or check your registration status online through the County.
Property tax bills and payments are issued by the County, not the City.
Vehicle registration and driver's licenses are a State (DMV) function.

agency: Superior Court of California, San Diego
note: Court matters, including contesting a traffic citation, go through the Superior Court.
Some City library branches serve as passport acceptance facilities; the application itself is federal.
Marriage licenses are issued by the County Clerk, not the City.
Gas and electric service is provided by a private utility, not the City.

agency: County Dept of Environmental Health & Quality (DEHQ)
note: Restaurant and food facility health permits are issued by the County.
File a DBA with the County if your business name isn't just your legal name plus a description.

agency: California Dept of Tax and Fee Administration (CDTFA)
note: Required to sell or lease tangible goods subject to CA sales tax; free and usually instant online.
Forming an LLC, corporation, or LP is a State filing, separate from the City's Business Tax Certificate.
EINs are issued by the federal government, free of charge.
Register as an employer for state payroll tax withholding through EDD.
Contractor licensing is a State function, separate from any City building permit.
MTS is a separate regional transit agency, not a City department; station park-and-ride lots are 24-hour, no overnight RV parking.
SDHC is a separate public agency from the City that administers rental assistance and affordable housing programs, not something processed at City Hall.

topic: Tenant rights / eviction / rent increase disputes
agency: Legal Aid Society of San Diego
note: The City doesn't adjudicate landlord-tenant disputes; Legal Aid Society offers free or low-cost help for renters.
